messages:
arjun.k: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482 — vanguard-13b tokenizer + serving config updates. Trying to get acceptance checks done before tomorrow's deploy window (11:00 PT). Checklist is in the PR description. can someone take a quick look? cc @maya @taylor-r

maya: on it, i'll run the smoke tests in ~30m and report back.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #482 — jobs: smoke, unit, perf (queued)

taylor-r: skimming the diff now — quick q: vocab size changed by +16 tokens, is that intentional? any downstream rerank/embedding dimension impacts?

arjun.k: yep intentional — added unk token handling and a few control tokens for chat probing. rerank/embedding dims unchanged; left a note in the PR about embedding checksum and a small migration note to add. perf profile attached: ~1.2x token/sec vs sable baseline locally. also left suggested quant profile under profiles/quant/vanguard-13b.json

jamie: CI shows a flaky in tokenization/test_normalize on a windows runner — looks unrelated but tagging eng-infra in case it blocks green.

infra-bot: Created issue #1032 to track flaky Windows tokenization test and linked CI run.

maya: smoke done: no OOMs, sample generations look sane. one tiny nit: trailing spaces in vocab.txt — i can strip in a follow-up commit if you prefer. sampling quality looked unchanged on our sanity prompts.

taylor-r: LGTM for tokenizer changes. leaving config/perf flags review to runtime folks — @jamie can you eyeball the serving flags (batching/prefill/kv cache) in the PR?

jamie: i'll run the full perf suite tonight and post numbers. quick note: please ensure the canary routing includes the fallback variant (vanguard-13b-fallback) in case we hit regression.

arjun.k: added fallback routing note to the PR description and a short rollback plan. i'll also add a small migration note re: embeddings. if perf looks good, merge before 11:00 PT tomorrow or i'll queue it for the canary window.

maya: :thumbsup: sounds good. also make a short changelog line mentioning tokenizer behavior (normalization tweak).

ci-bot: CI finished for PR #482 — smoke ✅ unit ✅ perf: WARN (one perf test slower by 3%) — full perf suite in progress: https://ci.redwood/482/runs/9001

jamie: full perf finished: token/sec +0.8% vs baseline, peak mem +1% (within our SLO). no regressions >5%. i've run a short A/B on latency p95, looks stable. approving config changes. LGTM.

taylor-r: thanks — i added a 1-paragraph rollback snippet into the PR with commands to flip routing and disable the new quant profile.

maya: :eyes: i'll re-run the eval set in the morning and merge after jamie's perf signoff.

arjun.k: thanks all — merging now. i'll monitor logs during canary and ping here if anything odd shows up.

ci-bot: Merged PR #482 by @arjun.k — deploy pipeline started (canary).
